text: A股三大指数今日集体下跌，截至收盘，上证指数跌0.43%，深证成指跌2.03%，创业板指跌2.61%，北证50跌2.46%，科创50指数跌2.1%。全市场成交额15507亿元，较上日缩量3659亿元，全市场超4300只个股下跌。板块题材上，AI视频、风电设备、银行、游戏、汽车整车、证券板块涨幅居前；贵金属、粮食概念、能源金属、油气开采及服务、MLCC、乳业板块跌幅居前。盘面上，字节跳动旗下海外短剧应用PineDrama下载量突破1亿，AI视频方向延续活跃，果麦文化、新华都、龙版传媒等10余股涨停。银行板块震荡上扬，中国银行、建设银行、工商银行盘中再创新高
text_en: The three major A-share indices all fell today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.43%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.03%, the ChiNext Index fell 2.61%, the BSE 50 fell 2.46%, and the STAR 50 Index fell 2.1%. Total market turnover was 1.5507 trillion yuan, down 365.9 billion yuan from the previous day, and more than 4,300 stocks in the whole market declined. By sector theme, AI video, wind power equipment, banks, gaming, complete vehicles, and securities led the gains; precious metals, grain concept, energy metals, oil and gas extraction and services, MLCC, and dairy led the declines. On the board, ByteDance's overseas short drama app PineDrama surpassed 100 million downloads, and the AI video direction remained active, with more than 10 stocks including Guomai Culture, Xinhua Du, and Longban Media hitting the daily limit. The banking sector fluctuated upward, with Bank of China, China Construction Bank, and ICBC hitting intraday new highs again.
